messages:
Maya: Morning — quick cross-check for tomorrow's release train. Who is landing in the 11:30–12:30 window? Need smoke owners + rollback-ready leads.
Alex: Platform -> 11:30–12:00. PR #4523 is the change. I'll own smoke and rollback. @Maya FYI.
Jen: Infra still needs the db migration ack. Can infra move to 12:00? We're not confident on the migration timing.
Mark: We can shift infra to 12:05, needs ~20m but can cut to 12:25 if we parallelize checks.
Carlos: Data infra has a hot job; we'll opt out of this wave. Picking next one.
Maya: Ok final proposal: Platform 11:30–12:00 (Alex smoke), Infra 12:05–12:25 (Jen smoke). Carlos skips. Anyone to own rollback coord?
Jen: I'll be infra rollback lead. Plan: snapshot restore tag infra/v2026-03-17, and `kubectl rollout undo deployment/infra --to-revision=3` as immediate step.
Alex: Platform rollback plan: revert to canary tag platform/canary-2026-03-16, command is `helm rollback platform 2` or revert PR. I'll standby during infra window to help routing fallback.
Maya: Sweet. Can we get an explicit deploy ordering list in thread? I'll post to the release board after that.
Mark: Ordering: 1) platform-service (11:30) -> smoke (Alex). 2) routing + config (11:45) quick check -> if ok continue. 3) infra (12:05) -> smoke (Jen).
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: platform-service @ 1728589800; infra window reserved @ 1728593100. :white_check_mark:
Maya: Thanks all — I'll update the train and tag owners on the calendar. Ping here if anything slips.
